sources_considered.why: Primary disclosure of large-scale Alexa+ adoption and its LLM architecture. The retrieved version identifies a September 2026 update.
Firsthand testing covers both successful home control and remaining defects.
It also reports customer scale and engagement, but supplies no household reliability measurement.
The broad smart-home team description does not isolate LLM-based Alexa+ deployment or demonstrate reliability.

evidence_items.locator: Introduction, paragraph on Early Access participation
evidence_items.explanation: Amazon reports substantial Alexa+ participation, and the same article describes its LLM architecture, conversation, and home automation. Customer participation does not establish the number of homes using those capabilities dependably.

evidence_items.locator: Section Natural Smart Home Voice Controls
evidence_items.explanation: The reviewer successfully used natural-language home control and routine creation but also encountered device-control failures. This demonstrates practical capability without measuring reliability across millions of homes.

unresolved_gaps: The sources do not provide representative reliability measurements linked to millions of households.
Customer participation does not directly establish household deployment or dependable home-control use.
The claim provides no duration against which to classify the arrival date.
